result.instructions: Tools for Hotjar, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the surveys on our Hotjar site and which ones are enabled."; "Show the 20 latest responses to our post-checkout survey."; "What are the questions in our NPS survey?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hotjar data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hotjar_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hotjar_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hotjar_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. hotjar_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hotjar_list_surveys
tools.title: List surveys
tools.description: List the surveys of one Hotjar site: id, name, type (link, full_screen, popover), enabled state and creation time. Set with_questions to include each survey's questions. Returns results and next_cursor (null on the last page).

site_id.description: The Hotjar site id (digits). Find it in Hotjar → Sites & Organizations, under the organization.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from the previous page, to get the next page.

with_questions.description: Include the questions of each survey (default false).

tools.name: hotjar_get_survey
tools.title: Get survey
tools.description: Get one survey with its questions (id, text, type, choices, labels). Use the question ids to read the answers from hotjar_list_survey_responses.

site_id.description: The Hotjar site id (digits). Find it in Hotjar → Sites & Organizations, under the organization.

survey_id.description: The survey id, for example survey_f5937a53-.... Get it from hotjar_list_surveys.

tools.name: hotjar_list_survey_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List the responses to one survey, newest first (the API cannot filter by date). Each response has answers (question_id, answer, comment, tags, sentiment), device, browser, country, origin URL and user attributes. Needs an Ask Scale plan. Returns results and next_cursor (null on the last page).

site_id.description: The Hotjar site id (digits). Find it in Hotjar → Sites & Organizations, under the organization.

survey_id.description: The survey id, for example survey_f5937a53-.... Get it from hotjar_list_surveys.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from the previous page, to get the next page.
